limits: Cost path includes admission, preparation, proof, cache scan, dispatch, actual actor copy and exact CPU2 fallback. Native metadata adapters and matrix construction are excluded.
Transform, skinning, lighting, FTRV/FSRRA execution, data-cache/bus traffic, PVR/DMA, game scheduling and full renderer linking/execution are outside this evidence.
The world caller is tested through actual production bodies with controlled hardware/math boundaries and complete target compilation; it is not a world target timing measurement.
Interpreted arithmetic uses RN/DN1. RZ is covered by the analytic bounds and admission-predicate tests; FPU exception flags/traps are not emulated.
Instruction-cache sensitivity uses one standalone synthetic link layout. Other renderer code, real asset hit rates and physical-console frame times remain unmeasured.
An eligible but uncertain reciprocal case adds 52.7% modeled cycles for one group before exact fallback. Admission is a cost filter, not a speedup guarantee.
BACKFACE_CONE_FRONT remains off by default; no play recipe changes.
